Class PlayerPose

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.vision.PlayerPose
public final class PlayerPose extends Object
Everything about a player that decides how the game draws it at one moment: where it stands, which way it faces, and how far its limbs are into their animations. These are the same values the game's own renderer reads.
